params.name: preset
params.label: Preset
params.description: Picking one writes its size into Width and Height, in Units: Letter, A4, Legal and Tabloid as portrait sheets, HD, 4K and Square as pixel sizes. Shows the last one picked.

params.name: units
params.label: Units
params.description: Unit Width and Height, and every length on the nodes drawing onto this page, are written in. Changing it converts Width and Height, so the page keeps its size.

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.description: Page width in Units; with Height, the page's size. A preset writes it, and any other width can be typed; swap it with Height for landscape. In Pixels its physical size depends on Resolution.

params.name: height
params.label: Height
params.description: Page height in Units; with Width, the page's size. A preset writes it, and any other height can be typed. In Pixels its physical size depends on Resolution.

params.name: resolution
params.label: Resolution
params.description: Pixels per inch (DPI). More pixels for a paper size; for pixel presets it sets the physical size. Stored in exported PNGs so prints come out at size.

params.name: color
params.label: Color
params.description: Background colour the whole page is filled with before anything is drawn on it.

params.name: opacity
params.label: Opacity
params.description: Opacity of the background fill, 0 to 1. At 0 the page is clear and only what is drawn on it shows; clear areas are see-through in the viewport and PNG.

params.name: position
params.label: Position
params.description: Where the centre of the page stands in the 3D scene, in world units. The page lies in the XY plane facing +Z at its physical size.
